causal_state_machine.ambiguous: all events not uniquely satisfying one state are no-trade
causal_state_machine.event_clock: large first-ten-second perpetual flow at a quarter-hour boundary, with high turnover and aligned one-minute price response
causal_state_machine.permanent_discovery: spot return and spot flow participate, futures-specific basis share remains limited, and the joint impact is retained through two completed confirmation minutes
causal_state_machine.transient_overshoot: spot participation is weak, the perpetual outruns spot, the futures-specific basis starts decaying, impact retention is low, and follow-through flow fails

first_week.selection_method: deterministic shuffle of eligible Monday weeks from 2023-01-02 through 2025-12-29 after excluding every previously revealed candidate-02 week

performance_engine: NautilusTrader 1.230.0 via the existing candidate-02 run_window path
promotion_rule: Only a prospectively locked state portfolio satisfying the central-plus-adjacent plateau and component sanity checks can be frozen unchanged before a second BTC week is selected.

research_basis.fragmented_price_discovery: Spot and futures price discovery leadership varies with trading activity and market state, so common spot participation and futures-specific basis dislocation are separated.
research_basis.impact_decomposition: Metaorder impact contains transient mechanical and persistent informational components; post-event retention is therefore measured explicitly.
research_basis.order_flow_imbalance: Short-horizon price changes depend on order-flow imbalance scaled by available depth, so futures flow is an event input rather than a complete directional scenario.

structural_plateau.promotion_requirement: The 30-minute state portfolio and at least one adjacent horizon must satisfy every weekly gate. The 30-minute component runs must also show that no negative-expectancy state is being hidden by aggregation.
